title: Canonical module base-change coordinate isomorphisms and comparison
statement: Choose the shared derived categories and additive tensor pullbacks [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $f:X\to S$, $g:S'\to S$, $g':X'\to X$, and $f':X'\to S'$ form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $G$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $c:Lg'^*(G[0])\to(g'^*G)[0]$ satisfy IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map]. For arbitrary scheme isomorphisms $e_S:S\cong A$, $e_T:S'\cong B$, set $f_A=f\mathbin{\gg}e_S$, $g_A=e_T^{-1}\mathbin{\gg}g\mathbin{\gg}e_S$, $P=X\times_A B$, $p:P\to X$, $q:P\to B$, and $T=R(e_T^{-1})_*$. Fix $c_0:Lp^*(G[0])\to(p^*G)[0]$ satisfying IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map]. There exist isomorphisms $a:Lg^*Rf_*(G[0])\cong T(Lg_A^*Rf_{A,*}(G[0]))$ and $b:Rf'_*(g'^*G)[0]\cong T(Rq_*((p^*G)[0]))$, such that $(\beta\mathbin{\gg}Rf'_*(c))\mathbin{\gg}b=a\mathbin{\gg}T(\beta_A\mathbin{\gg}Rq_*(c_0))$. Here $\beta$ and $\beta_A$ are the canonical derived mates [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. No open restriction or affine hypothesis occurs.

source.place: Tags 08HY and 0D5T, coordinate transport and composition

proof.text: Identify the cartesian square with the chosen coordinate pullback by its unique pullback isomorphism. Derived pullback and direct-image composition, cancellation of inverse coordinates, and ordinary tensor-pullback composition give source and target isomorphisms a0 and b0. Transport the witnessing left-derived counit for c to obtain a comparison cT.

Transpose the two derived base-change arrows under the second-projection adjunction. Pullback composition identifies both transposes with pullback of the same counit, after inverse coordinates cancel. Naturality gives (beta followed by Rf_prime(c)) followed by b0 = a0 followed by T(betaA followed by Rq(cT)).

The independent hc0 need not use the transported counit. Apply modulePullbackComparison_target_automorphism to c0 and cT to obtain an ordinary module automorphism alpha with cT=c0 followed by alpha[0]. Let d=T(Rq(alpha[0])). Take a=a0 and b=b0 followed by d.inv. Functoriality and cancellation of d.hom followed by d.inv yield the required equation. This covers zero modules, empty schemes and identity coordinates, with no flatness or affine hypothesis.

theorem canonicalModuleBaseChange_iso_comparison_ab
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).Additive]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (G : X.Modules)
    (c : (derivedPullback g').obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').obj G))
    (hc : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison g' G c)
    {A B : Scheme.{u}} (eS : S ≅ A) (eT : S' ≅ B)
    (c0 : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst (f ≫ eS.hom)
      (eT.inv ≫ g ≫ eS.hom))).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback (f ≫ eS.hom)
          (eT.inv ≫ g ≫ eS.hom)).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (f ≫ eS.hom)
          (eT.inv ≫ g ≫ eS.hom))).obj G))
    (hc0 : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison
      (pullback.fst (f ≫ eS.hom) (eT.inv ≫ g ≫ eS.hom)) G c0) :
  let fA := f ≫ eS.hom
      let gA := eT.inv ≫ g ≫ eS.hom
      let E := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G
      let T := schemeDerivedDirectImage eT.inv
      ∃ a : (derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E) ≅
            T.obj ((derivedPullback gA).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage fA).obj E)),
        ∃ b : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').obj
              ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').obj G)) ≅
            T.obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd fA gA)).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback fA gA).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).obj G))),
          (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w E ≫
              (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map c) ≫ b.hom =
            a.hom ≫ T.map
              (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap fA (pullback.snd fA gA) gA (pullback.fst fA gA)
                pullback.condition E ≫ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd fA gA)).map c0)
